payload.core_mechanism_summary: Simulate buying: scan all booths, buy if affordable, then batch multiple full passes by dividing remaining money by sum of affordable booths, subtract and repeat until no purchase.
payload.rationale: Solution uses greedy choice: buy when possible. Heuristic batching with integer division speeds up simulation. Among candidate subtypes, greedy_sorting_order had highest score from rule-based system, though no sorting occurs. Chosen as best match given limited options.
